propositions: Manifest byte-equality tests fail intermittently under pytest-xdist when concurrent workers modify the git checkout, causing git status --porcelain to return different dirty-state between separate build_manifest calls within a single test

test_manifest_file_scope_contract_preserves_legacy_bytes compares two manifests built by separate calls that each invoke _signing.gate_code_version(), which shells live git status and stamps -dirty suffix nondeterministically
test_manifest_is_deterministic_and_path_independent performs multiple manifest byte-equality comparisons without pinning gate_code_version, exposing it to the same dirty-state race

Monkeypatching rebar.signing.gate_code_version to a constant in affected tests eliminates nondeterministic git provenance from the comparison, mirroring the pattern already used in test_no_pins_preserves_legacy_manifest_bytes
